title: Predicted structure of the 89-kDa invasion-tip protein of Holospora obtusa, an endonuclear symbiont of Paramecium caudatum, suggests a pH-dependent conformational change
authors: Yasuhiro Takenaka; Toshiyuki Murai; Toru Nakatsu; Yasushi Shigeri; Masahiro Fujishima
one_liner_zh: 该文用AlphaFold2预测和分子动力学模拟研究霍洛孢菌89-kDa入侵尖蛋白的pH依赖性构象变化，属于蛋白质结构预测与构象采样计算研究，与课题高度相关。
abstract: The endonuclear symbiont Holospora obtusa invades the macronucleus of Paramecium caudatum using an infectious-form invasion-tip containing a major 89-kDa periplasmic protein implicated in escape from the host digestive vacuole and macronuclear invasion. Sequence-based analyses placed this protein within a Holospora-specific family and predicted an N-terminal membrane-anchoring module and a long alpha-helical C-terminal region. AlphaFold2 modeling followed by molecular dynamics indicated that the C-terminal region forms an antiparallel, spectrin-repeat-like helical solenoid containing a localized three-helix coiled-coil. The protein exhibits a large pH-dependent charge difference, becoming 55 units more positive at pH 4 than at pH 7. Independent simulations at these pH values differed mainly in the relative orientation of the N-terminal core and C-terminal rod, described by DynDom as an approximately 35 degrees rigid-body rotation about a hinge centered on Gly291. However, none of the nearby glutamates (Glu273, Glu275, and Glu302) formed a pH-dependent salt bridge, and no specific protonation-dependent interaction responsible for the conformational difference was identified. We nonetheless propose, as a testable hypothesis, that acidification of the digestive vacuole may promote this reorientation, thereby repositioning the N-terminal membrane-anchoring module at the bacterial surface as an early step toward escape from the vacuole.
abstract_zh: 核内共生菌 *Holospora obtusa* 通过一种感染型入侵尖端侵入草履虫 (*Paramecium caudatum*) 的大核，该尖端含有一个主要的89-kDa周质蛋白，该蛋白与逃逸宿主消化泡及大核入侵有关。基于序列的分析将该蛋白归入一个 *Holospora* 特异性家族，并预测其具有N端膜锚定模块和长α螺旋C端区域。AlphaFold2建模结合分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 表明，C端区域形成反向平行的、类血影蛋白重复的螺旋螺线管，其中包含一个局部的三螺旋卷曲螺旋。该蛋白表现出显著的pH依赖性电荷差异，在pH 4时比pH 7时正电荷多55个单位。在这些pH值下的独立模拟主要差异在于N端核心与C端杆状区域的相对取向，DynDom将其描述为围绕Gly291铰链的约35度刚体旋转。然而，附近的谷氨酸残基（Glu273、Glu275和Glu302）均未形成pH依赖性盐桥，也未鉴定出导致构象差异的特异性质子化依赖相互作用。尽管如此，我们提出一个可检验的假说：消化泡的酸化可能促进这种重取向，从而将N端膜锚定模块重新定位至细菌表面，作为逃逸泡体的早期步骤。
